question: Write an SQL query to find total sales units per region.
correct_answer: SELECT region, SUM(units_sold) FROM sales GROUP BY region;

question: Write an SQL query to find the average units sold per model across all regions.
correct_answer: SELECT model, AVG(units_sold) FROM sales GROUP BY model;

question: Write an SQL query to find the model with the highest average repair cost.
correct_answer: SELECT model, AVG(repair_cost) FROM warranties WHERE repair_cost > 0 GROUP BY model ORDER BY AVG(repair_cost) DESC LIMIT 1;
